name: log_sequoia_top_3
what: the cut end of a giant sequoia log: the SAME layout as the attached log top (the same many dense concentric rings, clearly drawn, the pale sapwood band and the bark edge), redrawn in sequoia colours: the heartwood rings a warm cinnamon red-brown (#a04c2e to #d8905e) with thin darker ring lines (#6a2c18), a pale pinkish-tan sapwood band (#d8b08a) inside the bark, and a 3 px edge of thick fibrous dark red-brown bark (#5e2a18). Every cell filled, no border, flat face-on.
